stoneMetalSeparation.note: StoneReference intersecting a production component (e.g. prongs, for a physically plausible grip) is an expected reference relationship, never evidence that its geometry was fused into production metal.

relevantIntersections.note: Skipped the boolean-common operation: a prior distance measurement already proved this pair is separated beyond the contact tolerance.

Positive intersection volume confirms real 3D overlap. A NO_INTERSECTION result with a distance of exactly 0 can still mean the shapes touch at a surface with zero enclosed volume — see 471-component-intersection-model.md.
